origins.section: A MILP Solver Keeps Two Numbers: the Best Plan Found and a Bound on Every Plan
The Incumbent Rises and the Bound Falls Until They Meet
The Relative Gap Divides by a Number Each Solver Chooses

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-claim: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-claim: The **best bound** is a value the solver has proved no plan can beat. For a maximization it is the highest LP value among the nodes still waiting to be explored: every plan not yet ruled out lives in one of those nodes
recorded.prompt:q-width: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-width: absolute gap = |best bound - incumbent| ... It is also only an upper limit on what the incumbent leaves behind. The true optimum can be anywhere inside the bracket
recorded.prompt:q-percent: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-percent: **HiGHS divides by the incumbent.** ... **SCIP divides by the smaller of the two in size.** ... in the minimization the bound is the smaller
